attack_or_failure_path: An attacker or compromised component writes a trigger or false record directly into a writable memory or knowledge store; later retrieval changes belief or action.
evidence_status: Peer-reviewed attack evidence in AgentPoison; Generalist likelihood and effect remain unmeasured.
preventive_controls: Authenticate writer and channel; append immutable raw event; type source; candidate-only derived writes; independent evidence roots; authorize before ranking; mediate tools.
detective_controls: Log candidate creation promotion retrieval and tool effects; poison canaries; provenance and source-class validation; outlier and trigger probes.
corrective_controls: Quarantine candidate; invalidate descendants; create correction edge; rebuild affected index; rollback promotion epoch without reviving tombstones.
evaluation: Replicate AgentPoison where possible; adapt to candidate/promote boundary; measure attempt candidate promotion retrieval influence effect and persistence separately.
residual_risk: Unknown triggers and compromised trusted writers remain possible; a verifier sharing the same failure can approve poison.

attack_or_failure_path: An attacker without store access shapes ordinary-looking interactions until the agent records attacker-chosen content as useful memory.
evidence_status: Peer-reviewed attack evidence in MINJA; transfer to this architecture is unmeasured.
preventive_controls: Rate- and purpose-bound writes; user-claim source type; no approval inferred from wording; minimum independent support for authoritative promotion; separate writer and verifier; capability-independent memory.
detective_controls: Detect repeated semantic steering; record provenance roots; alert on promotion from one external principal; probe semantically nearby benign queries.
corrective_controls: Quarantine attacker-linked roots and descendants; demote promoted items; apply authoritative correction; rotate policy or verifier; replay promotion log.
evaluation: Run fixed and adaptive MINJA-style multi-turn sequences under equal query budgets; include delayed triggers and benign conversational controls.
residual_risk: A patient attacker can imitate benign correction patterns; false-positive controls can reject legitimate personalization.

attack_or_failure_path: Untrusted instructions embedded in pages files messages or tool output are stored and later treated as commands or policy.
evidence_status: Peer-reviewed prompt-injection evidence in AgentDojo and InjecAgent; recent preprint evidence in MPBench and Bad Memory.
preventive_controls: Treat tool and file text as untrusted data; preserve channel; prohibit content from granting authority; isolate procedural memory; explicit capability manifests; sandbox effects.
detective_controls: Taint/provenance tracing; content-to-capability transition log; policy violation detector; compare retrieved data with attempted instruction following.
corrective_controls: Block effect; revoke candidate or procedure; invalidate descendants; rotate exposed credentials; repair source and replay from clean epoch.
evaluation: Adapt AgentDojo InjecAgent MPBench and Bad Memory payloads through real ingestion paths; score store promotion retrieval proposal and executed effect.
residual_risk: Semantic boundaries between data and instructions remain imperfect in a generative model; opaque third-party tools can hide source context.

attack_or_failure_path: Several individually plausible records combine at retrieval or consolidation time into a harmful instruction false belief or capability path.
evidence_status: Recent preprint evidence in MemPoison; prevalence and transfer are not established.
preventive_controls: Graph support by independent roots; joint-risk checks over candidate sets; procedural mediation; bounded multi-record synthesis; generated combinations remain generated.
detective_controls: Composition-aware probes; monitor risky co-retrieval; trace each conclusion to roots; evaluate combined effect rather than record-level filter output.
corrective_controls: Quarantine the composed claim and implicated descendants; narrow retrieval; add explicit contradiction or prohibition; rebuild affected summaries.
evaluation: Distribute fragments across sources time and dream cycles; measure single-fragment benign behavior and joint activation; vary retrieval top-k and compaction.
residual_risk: The dangerous property may emerge only under a future task or tool not present in the test suite.

attack_or_failure_path: A stored payload behaves benignly until a later keyword event time policy change or combination activates it.
evidence_status: Recent preprint evidence in Hidden in Memory and MemPoison; long-horizon production frequency is unknown.
preventive_controls: Do not promote on immediate benign behavior alone; source typing; no content-granted authority; time-bounded procedures; policy recheck at retrieval and execution.
detective_controls: Delayed-trigger corpus; persistence curves; re-evaluate memory after policy or capability change; scan for activation-condition patterns.
corrective_controls: Demote and invalidate descendants; revoke affected capability; rollback promotion; preserve tombstone or denial rule across restore.
evaluation: Separate injection and trigger phases with unrelated activity and multiple dream cycles; test post-restart post-policy-change and post-restore triggers.
residual_risk: Finite horizons cannot exclude later activation; trigger search is combinatorial.

attack_or_failure_path: An assistant error is stored summarized cited by later generated material and promoted as if repeated generations were independent support.
evidence_status: Recent preprint evidence of consolidation drift in Useful Memories; exact effect is architecture-specific.
preventive_controls: Immutable raw episodes; generated source class; lineage-aware root deduplication; generated items cannot support observational claims alone; candidate/promote separation.
detective_controls: Round-by-round correctness; confidence and support-root audit; generated-as-observed error; lineage-cycle detection; recursive-summary probes.
corrective_controls: Demote unsupported descendants; re-derive from raw roots; attach correction; lower confidence or abstain; block recursive source inflation.
evaluation: Replay stable facts errors and paraphrases through many consolidation schedules; compare dream off versus on and guarded versus unguarded.
residual_risk: A fluent false synthesis can pass model-based verification; external ground truth may not exist for subjective claims.

attack_or_failure_path: A dream reflection counterfactual or model summary loses its source type and is retrieved as evidence that an event occurred.
evidence_status: Design-specific threat motivated by generative-memory architectures; no prevalence estimate.
preventive_controls: Schema-level source-class enum; immutable origin and lineage; generated records stored separately; type-preserving transformations; promotion cannot relabel origin.
detective_controls: Property tests over every state transition; source-class confusion matrix; provenance reachability; audit sampled prompts for origin labels.
corrective_controls: Reject transaction; quarantine affected epoch; reconstruct from immutable roots; invalidate type-confused descendants.
evaluation: Seed synthetic dreams that resemble observations; copy and summarize them repeatedly; test export import re-index rollback and restore.
residual_risk: Implementation bypasses or lossy third-party indexes may drop metadata; natural-language consumers can ignore correct labels.

attack_or_failure_path: A newer statement overwrites historical truth or an older statement continues to drive current behavior despite correction.
evidence_status: LongMemEval and MemoryAgentBench test narrow update/conflict cases; safe authority resolution is not established.
preventive_controls: Validity intervals; event time and ingestion time; explicit supersedes and contradicts edges; authoritative field policies; no generic last-write-wins.
detective_controls: Conflict detection; stale-use rate; current versus historical query tests; confidence calibration by age and conflict status.
corrective_controls: Add correction edge; demote current status without deleting history; re-index temporal fields; request clarification when authority is unresolved.
evaluation: Cross legitimate corrections ambiguous conflicts clock skew and reordered delivery; score detection and resolution separately.
residual_risk: Authority may be contextual or unavailable; aggressive decay can erase durable facts.

attack_or_failure_path: An adaptive requester infers or elicits private interaction history through memory-augmented responses.
evidence_status: Peer-reviewed black-box evidence in MEXTRA; tested systems and privacy channels are limited.
preventive_controls: Minimize stored fields; sensitivity labels; purpose-bound access; authorize before ranking; redact prompt context; output disclosure policy; query rate limits.
detective_controls: Secret-canary monitors; retrieval and answer disclosure logs; adaptive extraction analytics; wrong-purpose access alerts.
corrective_controls: Block output; revoke session or capability; rotate exposed secrets; delete unnecessary records and descendants; investigate audit trail.
evaluation: MEXTRA-style adaptive queries plus exact and semantic canaries; measure candidate-set prompt answer and tool disclosure separately.
residual_risk: Semantic leakage can occur without verbatim retrieval; authorized users may still infer sensitive facts from aggregates.

attack_or_failure_path: A query retrieves or influences behavior using another principal's or tenant's memory because filtering occurs late or metadata is missing.
evidence_status: Design-specific critical threat; general access-control standards motivate controls but do not validate this implementation.
preventive_controls: Cryptographic tenant and principal binding; mandatory metadata; authorization before approximate search and ranking; tenant-scoped indexes or enforceable row policy; deny on missing scope.
detective_controls: Unique per-tenant canaries; pre-ranking candidate-set audit; noninterference tests; alerts on scope mismatch at every store and cache.
corrective_controls: Block response and effect; revoke session; rotate secret; purge leaked caches; repair index and policy; incident review.
evaluation: Lexically similar multi-tenant tapes; missing and malformed metadata; cache reuse; re-index; backup restore; concurrent deletion and query.
residual_risk: Zero observed events only bounds the tested population; shared embedding services caches logs and operators add channels.

attack_or_failure_path: Authorized memory irrelevant to the present purpose enters the model context and causes disclosure confusion or harmful action.
evidence_status: Design-specific threat; long-memory benchmarks measure retrieval quality but not full purpose limitation.
preventive_controls: Purpose sensitivity time and capability filters before ranking; least-context retrieval; relevance threshold; abstain when evidence is weak.
detective_controls: Context inspection; retrieval precision by purpose; unrelated-canary exposure; downstream influence attribution.
corrective_controls: Remove context; narrow policy or query; demote bad index entries; rebuild embeddings; correct resulting claims.
evaluation: Probe semantically similar records under different purposes times and capabilities; vary top-k history size and adversarial distractors.
residual_risk: Relevance models can encode spurious similarity; legitimate multi-purpose tasks complicate policy.

attack_or_failure_path: A stored workflow procedure or reflection is interpreted as standing authority to call tools use credentials or bypass current preconditions.
evidence_status: Agent Workflow Memory shows workflow-memory utility; prompt-injection suites show tool-side harm; safe procedural reuse is not established.
preventive_controls: Procedures are inert text by default; separate review and signing; explicit capability manifest; bind principal tenant purpose tool version expiry and preconditions; sandbox and confirm high-impact effects.
detective_controls: Log procedure selection plan tool proposal authorization and effect; test revoked capabilities and changed endpoints; policy-version mismatch alerts.
corrective_controls: Deny effect; revoke signature or capability; quarantine procedure and descendants; rotate credentials; require reapproval.
evaluation: Benign and poisoned workflows; endpoint substitution; revoked tool; stale credential; prompt-injected procedure; dream-generated procedure; partial execution failure.
residual_risk: A syntactically valid procedure may be semantically unsafe; approval can become stale as tools change.

attack_or_failure_path: Deleting a record leaves payload or semantic derivatives in summaries embeddings caches exports or backups and they later reappear.
evidence_status: Lifecycle risk derived from data architecture and erasure obligations; benchmark coverage is absent.
preventive_controls: Complete lineage graph; deletion tombstone; tier inventory; derivative-aware erase; backup manifest integration; block resurrection during import restore and re-index.
detective_controls: Closure traversal; exact and semantic canary search by tier; residual-reference count; restore and re-index probes.
corrective_controls: Erase residuals; rebuild indexes and summaries; propagate tombstone; invalidate caches and exports; document unavailable third-party copies.
evaluation: Delete before and after promotion embedding caching export and backup; then restart re-index restore and query paraphrases.
residual_risk: Unknown copies and model-provider retention may be outside control; semantic influence can survive without an exact payload.

attack_or_failure_path: Rolling back a bad promotion also rolls back later corrections permission changes or deletions and revives forbidden state.
evidence_status: Design-specific transactional threat; benchmark coverage is absent.
preventive_controls: Epoch manifests; immutable audit log; monotonic tombstones and revocations; separate data rollback from policy and deletion ledgers; atomic commit.
detective_controls: State-diff checker; invariant that deleted IDs and revoked capabilities stay blocked across epochs; replay audit.
corrective_controls: Reapply monotonic tombstones and revocations; restore clean promotion epoch; rebuild indexes; incident review.
evaluation: Interleave promotions corrections revocations and deletions; rollback to every prior epoch; restore backups from before tombstone creation.
residual_risk: Distributed stores may observe partial order; external tool effects cannot necessarily be rolled back.

threat: Dream-cycle denial of service or unsafe bulk promotion
attack_or_failure_path: Malicious or noisy episodes cause unbounded candidate generation verifier load storage growth or a large atomic-looking batch that hides correlated errors.
evidence_status: Design-specific operational threat; current memory-security benchmarks provide limited coverage.
preventive_controls: Per-tenant and global budgets; bounded recursion and fan-out; candidate deduplication; backpressure; batch-size limit; kill switch; atomic versioned commit; no automatic privilege increase.
detective_controls: Resource and queue telemetry; candidate lineage fan-out; repeated-root detector; per-cycle error sampling; anomaly and cost alerts.
corrective_controls: Abort cycle; discard uncommitted batch; quarantine root set; restore prior epoch; throttle source or tenant; investigate.
evaluation: Flood paraphrases cyclic summaries high-entropy content and adversarial conflicts; record latency cost backlog recovery and clean-tenant impact.
residual_risk: Fixed limits can become availability attacks against legitimate users; correlated verifier errors can survive sampling.

attack_or_failure_path: A peer message claims a role or asks a more privileged receiver to use a capability absent from the sender's task delegation or current user intent.
evidence_status: Design-specific critical threat; cross-agent messages are an untrusted input channel and current memory benchmarks do not validate delegation semantics.
preventive_controls: Host-authenticated agent and instance identities; signed task envelopes; cross-agent content typed as imported content; effective capability is the intersection of current policy and an attenuated delegation chain; effect-time audience purpose resource expiry and revocation checks.
detective_controls: Identity-envelope and delegation-chain logs; privilege-amplification alerts; confused-deputy probes; separate request proposal denial and executed-effect metrics.
corrective_controls: Deny the effect; revoke the delegation and instance; quarantine message-derived candidates; rotate exposed capability; audit downstream actions.
evaluation: Forge identity in text; replay envelopes; widen child grants; change audience purpose or resource; revoke or expire between receipt and effect; send indirect instructions between agents.
residual_risk: A compromised authorized sender can still make harmful in-scope requests; policy and user intent can be ambiguous.

attack_or_failure_path: Agents share a project database and a private principal task or agent record is retrieved by peers or copied into a project-wide summary without an authorized share transition.
evidence_status: Design-specific critical threat; tenant-only isolation tests do not cover mutually private scopes inside one project.
preventive_controls: Explicit visibility scopes; narrow capture default; authorization before ranking; owner-approved versioned private-to-shared transition; derived summaries inherit the narrowest input scope; sharing never grants capability.
detective_controls: Per-scope canaries; pre-ranking candidate-set audit; share-transition ledger; alerts on scope widening and missing owner authorization.
corrective_controls: Block retrieval or share; narrow scope; invalidate overbroad derivatives and caches; rebuild index; investigate any disclosure.
evaluation: Lexically similar private and shared records; named-agent versus project audience; concurrent scope widen and narrow; summary export re-index cache and backup restore.
residual_risk: Collaborative facts can mix private and shared evidence; inference may leak information without verbatim retrieval.

attack_or_failure_path: A delayed or restarted worker publishes with an expired lease or old snapshot; concurrent promotion deletion revocation or retry yields resurrection duplicate effects or two winning epochs.
evidence_status: SQLite provides physical transactions and a single writer but not semantic lease freshness delegation version order deletion precedence or external-effect exactly-once behavior.
preventive_controls: Monotonic fencing tokens; compare-and-swap on parent epoch and record version; in-transaction tombstone revocation and scope recheck; unique idempotency keys; durable effect intent and idempotent tool request; deletion and revocation dominate ordinary rollback.
detective_controls: Fence and epoch conflict logs; stale-publication acceptance metric; duplicate-write and duplicate-effect counters; invariant checks after forced schedules; resurrection canaries.
corrective_controls: Reject stale commit; rebase and fully revalidate losing work; apply monotonic tombstones and revocations; reconcile effects; restore last valid epoch without rolling back deletion.
evaluation: Deterministic barriers around validate commit delete revoke share retry and external effect; lease expiry process pause restart SQLITE_BUSY crash WAL snapshot re-index rollback and restore.
residual_risk: A remote effect may occur when its receipt is lost; broken clocks or a compromised fence allocator undermine the design.

attack_or_failure_path: A worker running model-controlled code directly opens copies locks or replaces the database WAL index ledger or socket state instead of using the authenticated protocol.
evidence_status: Same-UID Unix modes do not isolate processes; SQLite integrity and locks do not authenticate a model-driven writer.
preventive_controls: Sole trusted supervisor; distinct service identity or OS sandbox; worker has no database key or path authority; authenticated Unix peer credentials and task tokens; owner mode symlink and runtime checks.
detective_controls: Direct-open forged-row symlink WAL-copy lock-denial socket-replay and stolen-token probes; supervisor audit identifies every accepted actor.
corrective_controls: Fail closed; disable shared memory; revoke instance/token; restore from authenticated state; rotate keys and audit downstream records.
evaluation: Run every bypass from worker tool sandboxes before and during legitimate reads writes checkpoints restore and supervisor restart.
residual_risk: Local developer mode under one Unix identity cannot claim this boundary even when semantic tests pass.
